title: Papyrus editorial CLI uses Limatus SDK
description:
## Intent

Newsroom workflows call the **Limatus SDK**, not a forked in-tree editorial core. `papyrus editorial diagnose` / `options` stay as the operator CLI; they load publication profiles and drafts from Papyrus and delegate to Limatus.

## Done when

- `papyrus editorial diagnose` and `papyrus editorial options` call `limatus` (`diagnose` / `generate_options` / `load_config` / `render_annotations`).
- `papyrus_content.editorial_*` cores are shims re-exporting Limatus (or deleted if tests import Limatus directly).
- Papyrus-default skill/signals paths may remain here.
- Apply/publish stay human-gated. No auto-apply in procedures.
- Existing newsroom editorial tests pass against the SDK.
- `editorial-copyedit-cycle` skill points at the SDK wrapper, not in-tree rewrite internals.

## Out of scope

Limatus core changes. Newsroom UI. Publishing to origin/main of publication sites.

Tracks Limatus LIM-209793 / LIM-3ff8d0.
